# Complete R function atlas

Every public R function in the tagged v0.1.0 package is documented by its generated `.Rd` help page. This atlas is a **navigation map** rather than a second implementation of API documentation. Each link opens the current pkgdown-rendered function reference, including the authoritative arguments, value description and examples drawn from the package source.

**Coverage:** 155 exported functions in 14 mutually exclusive research families. An automated website build audit compares the reference index against `NAMESPACE` and verifies that an `.Rd` manual exists for every export.

[Browse the reference index](../reference/index.html) · [Workflow atlas](workflows-atlas.html) · [Scientific limitations](scientific-status.html)
